name: Sauce Essentials Live Resin Disposable | Sweet ZZ
description:
The Dream Pen is formulated specifically for a great night’s sleep. Made with a blend of super indica Sweet ZZ, CBN, CBD and Liquid Diamonds is the perfect combination to help users fall asleep and stay asleep. CBN, or Cannabinol, is a rare, minor cannabinoid found in the cannabis plant that is known for its ability to combat insomnia, inflammation, and pain. Don’t let insomnia ruin your nights, drift away with Dream Pen.

Taste: Fruity, Grape, Blueberry

Feel: Sleepy, Relaxed, Pain Relief
